question.text: A Category III AIF close-ended fund can be wound up by investor resolution passed at a meeting of unit holders representing:

answer.text: 75% by value of their investment in the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.17, 75% of investors by value of investment can pass a resolution to wind up the fund. The Trap: 50%/two-thirds are not the threshold for winding-up (though two-thirds is for tenure extension). Cross-Exam Context: 75% winding-up threshold also applies to Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Do not confuse the two-thirds tenure-extension threshold with the 75% winding-up threshold.
